name: Between two boats · Stern-to
description: Reverse into a free slot in a row of boats moored stern-to on the east quay, between a catamaran and a monohull, in a light crosswind; make fast both stern lines, then the lazy line.
author: Leopard (from an independent agent's first draft)

steps.label: PREPARE
steps.title: Stand off and prepare.
steps.hint: Keep your boat's centre in the blue stand-off circle for 10 seconds. Put the fenders out on both sides (Crew & lines): you will lie between two boats. Look at the free slot on the east quay, between the catamaran and the monohull: about 8.5 m wide for your 7 m beam.
steps.linesRefused: Not yet: prepare in the stand-off area first

radio.start: Leopard, marina office. This is a game, not certified training. Your berth is the free slot on the east quay, between the catamaran and the monohull: stern-to, lazy line provided. Stand off in the blue circle first and put fenders out on both sides.
radio.enter: In the stand-off area. Fenders out port and starboard. The breeze is from the north, across the slot: it will set you towards the monohull on your port side as you back in.
radio.reset: You drifted out of the stand-off area. Come back in; the count restarts.
radio.done: The slot is yours. Turn your stern to it and back in slowly, bow west.

steps.label: INTO THE SLOT
steps.title: Back into the slot, stern first.
steps.hint: Line up in the fairway with your stern towards the slot and the bow pointing west, a little upwind (north) of the slot's centre line. Go astern gently on both engines and steer with them: more astern on one side swings the stern the other way. Straighten up in the mint box with the stern about a metre off the quay and hold still for 3 seconds.
steps.linesRefused: Stop in the mint box first, then pass the stern lines

radio.start: Back into the free slot, bow west. Dead slow astern. Mind the monohull downwind on your port side.
radio.done: Stopped in the slot. Stern lines to B07 and B08, then pick up the lazy line.

steps.label: SECURE
steps.title: Stern lines, then the lazy line.
steps.hint: Make fast the port quarter line to B07 and the starboard quarter line to B08 from Crew & lines, in neutral. Then pick up the lazy line at the quay and lead it to the bow.
steps.hintAlongside: Amber area: pick up the lazy line once a stern line is on, then Take in until it holds the bow up to windward and the stern off the quay. Keep both levers in neutral.

radio.done: Secured stern-to. Welcome to the marina.

complete.title: Berthed stern-to.
complete.hint: Moored with +{penalty} s penalties. Open the debrief for your score and one thing to try; Retry (R) to go again.
complete.radio: Secured stern-to in {time} s with +{penalty} s penalties. A game, not certified training: practise this with an instructor on the water.

tips.contacts: You touched something {count}× (the quay or a neighbour). Back in slower, keep the stern a metre off the quay, and correct early for the crosswind.
tips.fendersLate: Your fenders were not out on both sides when you arrived. Put them out in the stand-off area: the crew needs 3 seconds.
tips.failed: {failure}. Fenders only cover the sides of your hulls: keep your bow and stern clear of the neighbours, and have fenders out on both sides before you back in.
